messages.subject: Reactive data issue
parts:
Hi everyone!

The below code snippet works fine in R but blows up when used within a shiny reactive structure.  Any comments or suggestions on how to get this work would be much appreciated!

I'll paste the working basic-R code first followed by my shiny implementation and the error.

Thank you!


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
x  = c(173, 169, 176, 166, 161, 164, 160, 158, 180, 187)
x1 = c(184, 102, 830,  76, 895, 105, 654, 564, 109, 204)
y  = c(80, 68, 72, 75, 70, 65, 62, 60, 85, 92)
y1 = c(56, 78, 56, 31, 34, 12,  4, 65, 98, 89)

inData = data.frame(x,x1,y,y1)

summary(inData)

outData <-subset(inData,select=c(x,y))

summary(outData)


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#Shiny code - dynamically subset frame based on user input
# This has been tried with the data frame declared out side of the reactive block

  outData <- reactive({
   
    x  = c(173, 169, 176, 166, 161, 164, 160, 158, 180, 187)
    x1 = c(184, 102, 830,  76, 895, 105, 654, 564, 109, 204)
    y  = c(80, 68, 72, 75, 70, 65, 62, 60, 85, 92)
    y1 = c(56, 78, 56, 31, 34, 12,  4, 65, 98, 89)
   
    inData <- data.frame(x,x1,y,y1)
   
    subset(inData,select=c(x,y))
 })
  summary(outData)


The error is:
Warning: Error in [[: object of type 'closure' is not subsettable
Stack trace (innermost first):
    39: summary.default
    38: summary
    37: server [C:/Data/Shiny_APP/Shiny_1/Shiny_test_7_inputs.R#59]
     1: runApp
Error in object[[i]] : object of type 'closure' is not subsettable

messages.author: 4317e7b9c140bf2d
messages.subject: Re: Reactive data issue
parts:
In general, object of type 'closure' is not subsettable means you are trying to subset a function. Reactives are functions, so you need to say summary(outData()).

You'll also need to wrap the summary() in a renderText(), or probably better, a renderPrint() and assign it to a textOutput()/verbatimTextOutput() if you want to see it on the screen.

Also, your reactive will only run once because nothing inside it ever changes.

Tom
